metadata.query: How do I best hang a picture?

final_answer: To best hang a picture, first choose the right spot, mark the spot, use a level to draw a horizontal line, locate the wall studs, mark them, measure the distance between the hanging hooks on the back of your picture frame, mark these points on the wall above your horizontal line, drill pilot holes, insert wall anchors if necessary, and hang your picture using picture hangers or hooks. (Sources: DIY Network, HGTV)
